CVE-2026-128085 (GHSA-q7gw-24fr-5p69) is an incomplete fix in OpenTelemetry-Go's attribute value length limit: the truncation code in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk (1.33.0 up to 1.47.0), go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log (0.9.0 up to 1.47.0) and go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace (1.35.0 up to 1.47.0) does not count valid U+FFFD replacement characters, so attribute values made of them can exceed the configured AttributeValueLengthLimit and the memory bound it enforces. It is fixed in release 1.47.0 of all three modules: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-q7gw-24fr-5p69, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/commit/017b08c7f1018b619991aaf6b2299d4beb9da1d3, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/releases/tag/v1.47.0. Read the Go build information and the Go function table of every ELF file in every build-dev package published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 2.6.4-r0 through the current 2.29.1-r1, for x86_64 and aarch64 (2.6.4-r0 is published for aarch64 only), every download checked against the index checksum; version 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times in each index with the same source commit, and the copy the repository serves was read. Each holds one program, /usr/bin/build: every build up to 2.28.0-r4 carries go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk 1.38.0 to 1.45.0 and go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace 1.40.0 to 1.45.0, inside the affected ranges (2.28.0-r4 has 1.45.0 of both), and 2.28.0-r5 and every later build carry sdk and trace 1.47.0, the fixed release. The fix (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/commit/017b08c7f1018b619991aaf6b2299d4beb9da1d3) changes the attribute truncation in trace/auto.go of go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace and in the SDK's attrnorm packages. The function go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace.truncate is in the Go function table of /usr/bin/build in every build, so the vulnerable code is linked and the range follows the module versions; the SDK's span and log-record truncation functions (go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace truncate and truncateAttr, and the sdk/internal/attrnorm Truncate functions) are not in the Go function table of any build. The same function-table search finds runtime.main in every Go program. No build contains go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log.
